summary: Backend engineer with eight years building payment and identity systems at scale. Happiest where correctness matters and the on-call pager stays quiet.

experience.description: Technical lead for the ledger that settles every transaction on the platform.
achievements: Rebuilt settlement as an append-only ledger, cutting month-end reconciliation from three days to under an hour.
Cut p99 authorisation latency from 840ms to 190ms by removing a synchronous fraud call from the hot path.
Introduced contract tests across nine services, ending a recurring class of release-day outages.

experience.description: Owned the authentication service behind twelve million monthly sign-ins.
achievements: Migrated password storage to Argon2 with zero forced resets and no measurable latency change.
Designed the tenant isolation model that unblocked the company's first enterprise contracts.
Built the ingest pipeline that grew from two thousand to four million events a day without a rewrite.
